MktCalcInsightObjectDef.description: This score indicates how much this individual typically interacts with your marketing communications.
MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c, FIRST(rankQuery.Rule1_Score__c) AS Rule1_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule2_Score__c) AS Rule2_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule3_Score__c) AS Rule3_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule4_Score__c) AS Rule4_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule5_Score__c) AS Rule5_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule6_Score__c) AS Rule6_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule7_Score__c) AS Rule7_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule8_Score__c) AS Rule8_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule9_Score__c) AS Rule9_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule10_Score__c) AS Rule10_Score__c,FIRST(rankQuery.Rule11_Score__c) AS Rule11_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule12_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule13_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule14_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule15_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule16_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule17_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule18_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule19_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule20_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule21_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule22_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule23_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule24_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule25_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule26_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule27_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule28_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule29_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule30_Score__c, FIRST(rankQuery.Engagement_Score__c) AS Engagement_Score__c, FIRST(rankQuery.Raw_Engagement_Score__c) AS Raw_Engagement_Score__c FROM (SELECT Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.IndividualId__c AS IndividualId__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c ORDER BY MAX(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Engagement_Score__c) DESC) AS Rank__c, FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule1_Score__c) AS Rule1_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule2_Score__c) AS Rule2_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule3_Score__c) AS Rule3_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule4_Score__c) AS Rule4_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule5_Score__c) AS Rule5_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule6_Score__c) AS Rule6_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule7_Score__c) AS Rule7_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule8_Score__c) AS Rule8_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule9_Score__c) AS Rule9_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule10_Score__c) AS Rule10_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Rule11_Score__c) AS Rule11_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Engagement_Score__c) AS Engagement_Score__c,FIRST(Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.Raw_Engagement_Score__c) AS Raw_Engagement_Score__c FROM Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio INNER JOIN ssot__Individual__dlm ON Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.IndividualId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c INNER JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c INNER JOIN UnifiedIndividual__dlm ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY Individual_Engagement_Score_VY89__cio.IndividualId__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS rankQuery LEFT JOIN UnifiedIndividual__dlm ON (UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = rankQuery.Unified_Individual__c) GROUP BY Unified_Individual__c
